remarks: Sellers will consider offers between $400,000 and $425,000. Classic curb appeal meets comfortable, updated living in this brick-front East Amherst Colonial. Inside, a bright and inviting floor plan offers a spacious living room, formal dining room, renovated eat-in kitchen and an impressive family room designed to be enjoyed year-round. The kitchen features white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, tile flooring and recessed lighting, with an easy flow into the adjoining family room. Soaring vaulted ceilings, a gas fireplace set against a dramatic black brick feature wall, custom built-ins and an expansive Palladian-style window make this space truly special while bringing in beautiful natural light and views of the wooded backyard. Upstairs you'll find three nicely sized bedrooms and an updated full bath. Outdoors, enjoy a private backyard retreat with a spacious stamped concrete patio, 4-person hot tub, large lawn and peaceful wooded backdrop—ideal for entertaining or simply unwinding. Additional highlights include 1.5 baths, a 2-car attached garage, furnace (2021), hot water tank (2022), whole-house generator (2022) and roof (2014). The location adds even more to love—within walking distance of Paradise Park and conveniently located near Transit Road shopping, dining and Transit Valley Country Club. A wonderful combination of space, style, privacy and convenience in desirable East Amherst.
